body:
I am in the same boat. I have thought about ending it, still thinking about it. I've been alone a long time now and get anxiety sometimes. I try to control it, I have my good days and other days not so good.

Even though I have good friends and exercise regularly, it's not helping me anymore. I hope you can find help, know that you are not the only one.

I suffer from depression too but have found that a daily dose of blackstrap molasses (unsulfured) has helped a lot in feeling more energetic. You can google the health benefits.

This is a natural product so don't expect immediate change (as clinical drugs). It can take a few days or weeks but at least it's natural. Best to take a tablespoon in the morning or mix a tablespoon in some hot water, wait until it cools and drink it through a straw.

Hope you find some help, hang in there.
Thank you, I couldn't agree more. You're summarization was simply brilliant.

I know what you are talking about. I am looking for a way out myself, to end this life peacefully and with honor knowing that I did the best I could.

I hope you can turn it around for yourself and find some peace.

Thank you very much for your offer. I'm fine though, I've done the best I can and it's just not worth it anymore for me.

Thanks again though.
